thesis_summary.thesis: West Pharmaceutical Services is a global supplier of injectable drug containment and delivery components. **[Fact]** FY2025 net sales were **$3.07 billion** (+6.2% versus $2.89 billion in 2024). **[Fact]** The company reports two segments: **Proprietary Products** (**$2.49 billion**, 81% of sales) and **Contract-Manufactured Products** (**$582 million**). **[Fact]** Proprietary Products sells elastomer stoppers, seals, vial and cartridge components, self-injection devices, and analytical lab services to biologic, generic, and pharmaceutical customers. **[Fact]** Contract-Manufactured Products assembles customer-owned components into finished injectable and diagnostic devices. **[Fact]** Cash from operations was **$754.8 million** and capital spending **$285.9 million**, yielding about **$6.45** of free cash flow per diluted share on **72.7 million** shares. **[Inference]** WST is a high-quality packaging compounder whose economics depend on validated component demand from injectable therapies, especially biologics and GLP-1 obesity drugs, with meaningful cyclicality from customer inventory management.
thesis_summary.why_market_wrong: There is **no clear dated mispricing signal** (HK predictive attribute: **none**). **[Inference]** The stock may embed optimism on GLP-1 injectable volumes and capacity expansions while under-weighting oral GLP-1 substitution risk, customer destocking cycles, and the earnings impact of CEO transition and restructuring charges. Return at today's price is **normalized owner cash flow**, not a catalyst with a single payoff date. Peer comparison (Aptar, Datwyler, Stevanato) frames whether injectable packaging scarcity is already fully priced at roughly **55 times** owner cash.

key_assumptions.input: Starting free cash flow per share
key_assumptions.source: FY2025 cash from operations $754.8M minus capital spending $285.9M, divided by 72.7M diluted shares (10-K filed 2026-02-17)

Proprietary Products mid-single-digit organic growth on biologics and injectable obesity therapies; contract manufacturing stable; margin holds on elastomer pricing; buybacks moderate from Q1 2026 pace
